restaurantName: Afternoon Tea at Millennium Gloucester Hotel London Kensington
bio: Experience the Timeless Charm of Traditional Afternoon Tea at Millennium Gloucester Hotel!  Indulge in the quintessential British tradition of Afternoon Tea and embark on a journey of delectable delights. Immerse yourself in a world of refined flavours and impeccable service as you partake in a truly British experience in the Humphrey’s Bar at the Ground Floor Lobby area.  From savoury to sweet menus, they offer a selection of mouth-watering delights, ensuring a memorable experience for all. For those following a vegan lifestyle, there is a thoughtfully crafted alternative sandwich menu, including delightful options like Cucumber and Tomato with vegan mayonnaise on white bread.  No Afternoon Tea would be complete without the pièce de résistance—a traditional freshly baked scone. Sink your teeth into its warm, buttery goodness, and enhance its flavour with luscious Dorset clotted cream and a selection of delectable jams.
pageTitle: Afternoon Tea at Millennium Gloucester Hotel London Kensington
